title: Government Code, Chapter 661 (Leave)
source_id: Tex. Gov't Code ch. 661, §§ 661.001-661.924 (Title 6, Subtitle B)
verified_how: Fetched https://tcss.legis.texas.gov/resources/GV/htm/GV.661.htm: heading 'CHAPTER 661. LEAVE' under TITLE 6. PUBLIC OFFICERS AND EMPLOYEES, sections 661.001 to 661.924. Listed in the current Government Code tree.
notes: State employees only. Texas has no general statutory paid leave or holiday pay for the private sector; private-sector vacation or sick pay is enforceable only as 'wages' under a written policy (Labor Code ch. 61).
